children: Erez Shachar, Director, reported selling 70,822 Class A ordinary shares through Qumra Capital I L.P. and Qumra Capital I Continuation Fund L.P. on Nov. 23, 2026, at a weighted average price of $10.1196 per share, and 53,628 shares through the same funds on Nov. 24, 2026, at a weighted average price of $10.3539 per share. The total sale amount was $1,271,949. Following the transactions, Shachar directly owned 80,053 shares and indirectly owned 3,037,123 shares through the funds. Shachar is a managing partner of Qumra Capital and disclaims beneficial ownership of the shares held by the funds, except to the extent of his pecuniary interest, if any.
